北 京 同 仁 堂 創 建 於1669年（清 朝 康 熙 八 年），自1723年 開 始 供 奉 御 藥，歷 經 八 代 皇 帝
188年。縱觀歷史，北京同仁堂於中醫藥行業一直享譽全國。在357年的風雨歷程中，
歷代同仁堂人始終恪守「炮製雖繁必不敢省人工，品味雖貴必不敢減物力」的古訓，樹
立「修合無人見，存心有天知」的自律意識，造就了製藥過程中兢兢業業、精益求精的                                                  文          化             傳        承                         創   新           共           振
嚴謹精神，其產品以「配方獨特、選料上乘、工藝精湛、療效顯著」而享譽海內外，並
                           得以世代弘揚                                                           RESONANCE OF                                                INNOVATION

                                                            Pillar Two assessment                                                                                                 支柱二評估

                                                         33 SUMMARY OF OTHER MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                                                     33 其他重大會計政策概要
                                                            This note provides a list of other material accounting policies adopted in the preparation of these                 本附註載列編製此等綜合財務報表時採納之其他重要的會計政策。除特別註明外，
                                                            consolidated financial statements. These policies have been consistently applied to all the years presented,        該等政策已貫徹應用於呈列的所有年度。本合併財務報表適用於本集團和其子公
                                                            unless otherwise stated. The consolidated financial statements are for the group consisting of the Company          司。
                                                            and its subsidiaries.


                                                            33.1 Business combination and goodwill                                                                              33.1 業務合併及商譽
                                                                  Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition method. The consideration transferred is          業務合併採用收購法入賬。所轉讓代價按收購日期的公平值計量，即本集
                                                                  measured at the acquisition date fair value which is the sum of the acquisition date fair values of             團向被收購方原擁有人所轉讓資產、自其所承擔負債以及本集團為換取被
                                                                  assets transferred by the Group, liabilities assumed by the Group to the former owners of the acquiree          收購方控制權所發行股權於收購日期之公平值總和。就各項業務合併而言，
                                                                  and the equity interests issued by the Group in exchange for control of the acquiree. For each                  本集團選擇按公平值或被收購方可識別資產淨值的應佔比例，計量於被收
                                                                  business combination, the Group elects whether to measure the non-controlling interests in the                  購方的非控股權益。非控股權益的所有其他組成部分乃按公平值計量。收
                                                                  acquiree at fair value or at the proportionate share of the acquiree’s identifiable net assets. All other       購相關成本於產生時支銷。
                                                                  components of non-controlling interests are measured at fair value. Acquisition-related costs are
                                                                  expensed as incurred.

                                                                  The Group determines that it has acquired a business when the acquired set of activities and assets             倘本集團所收購的一組業務及資產包括一項投入及一項實質過程，而兩者
                                                                  includes an input and a substantive process that together significantly contribute to the ability to            對產出具有重大貢獻，則確定其已收購一項業務。
214                                                               create outputs.

                                                                  When the Group acquires a business, it assesses the financial assets and liabilities assumed for                本集團收購業務時根據按合約條款、收購日期的經濟狀況及相關條件作出
                                                                  appropriate classification and designation in accordance with the contractual terms, economic                   適當分類及指定，以評估所收購及承擔的金融資產及負債，其中包括拆分
                                                                  circumstances and pertinent conditions as at the acquisition date. This includes the separation of              被收購方主合約中的嵌入式衍生工具。
                                                                  embedded derivatives in host contracts of the acquiree.

                                                                  Any contingent consideration to be transferred by the acquirer is recognised at fair value at the               收購方所轉讓的任何或然代價於收購日期按公平值確認。歸類為資產或負
                                                                  acquisition date. Contingent consideration classified as an asset or liability is measured at fair value        債的或然代價按公平值計量，而公平值的變動於損益確認。歸類為權益之
                                                                  with changes in fair value recognised in profit or loss. Contingent consideration that is classified as         或然代價毋須重新計量，其後結算在權益中入賬。

                                                                  equity is not remeasured and subsequent settlement is accounted for within equity.

                                                         33 SUMMARY OF OTHER MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES (CONTINUED)                                                         33 其他重大會計政策概要（續）
                                                            33.1 Business combination and goodwill (Continued)                                                                 33.1 業務合併及商譽（續）
                                                                Goodwill is initially measured at cost, being the excess of the aggregate of the consideration                   商譽初始按成本計量，即所轉讓代價、已確認非控股權益數額以及本集團
                                                                transferred, the amount recognised for non-controlling interests and any fair value of the Group’s               先前所持被收購方權益的任何公平值總額超出所收購可識別資產及所承擔
                                                                previously held equity interests in the acquiree over the identifiable assets acquired and liabilities           負債之差額。倘該代價及其他項目的總和低於所收購資產淨值的公平值，
                                                                assumed. If the sum of this consideration and other items is lower than the fair value of the net assets         則差額經重新評估後於損益確認為議價購買收益。
                                                                acquired, the difference is, after reassessment, recognised in profit or loss as a gain on bargain
                                                                purchase.

                                                                After initial recognition, goodwill is measured at cost less any accumulated impairment losses. Goodwill         於初始確認後，商譽乃按成本減任何累計減值虧損計量。商譽每年作減值
                                                                is tested for impairment annually or more frequently if events or changes in circumstances indicate that         測試，或如出現事件或情況轉變顯示賬面值可能出現減值，則會更頻繁地
                                                                the carrying value may be impaired. The Group performs its annual impairment test of goodwill as at              進行測試。本集團於每年十二月三十一日對商譽進行減值測試。就減值測
                                                                31 December. For the purpose of impairment testing, goodwill acquired in a business combination is,              試而言，業務合併所得的商譽自收購當日起分配至本集團預期受益於合併

                                                            33.3 Fair value measurement                                                                                          33.3 公允價值計量
                                                                The Group measures its equity investments at fair value at the end of each reporting period. Fair value            本集團於各報告期末按公平值經損益入賬之金融資產。公平值指於計量日
                                                                is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly                 期市場參與者之間的有序交易中，就出售資產將收取之價格或轉讓負債將
                                                                transaction between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value measurement is based               支付之價格。計量公平值時假設出售資產或轉讓負債之交易於資產或負債
                                                                on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the      的主要市場或（在未有主要市場的情況下）最有利市場進行。主要或最有利
                                                                principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most                  市場須為本集團能參與的市場。假設市場參與者基於最佳經濟利益行事，
                                                                advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market must be              資產或負債的公平值使用市場參與者為資產或負債定價時所用假設計量。
                                                                accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions
                                                                that market participants would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market
                                                                participants act in their economic best interest.

                                                                The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the circumstances and for which sufficient             本集團針對不同情況使用不同估值方法，確保有足夠數據計量公平值，並
                                                                data are available to measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and                     盡可能利用相關可觀察輸入數據，而減少使用不可觀察輸入數據。
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        219
                                                                minimising the use of unobservable inputs.

                                                                categorised within the fair value hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest level input that is         體而言屬重大之最低層輸入數據按下述公平值層級分類：

                                                            33.11 Impairment of financial assets                                                                               33.11 金融資產減值
                                                                The Group recognises an allowance for ECL for all debt instruments not held at fair value through                本集團對並非所持按公允價值經損益入賬之所有債務工具確認預期信貸虧
                                                                profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference between the contractual cash flows due in accordance            損（「預期信貸虧損」）撥備。預期信貸虧損乃基於根據合約到期的合約現金
                                                                with the contract and all the cash flows that the Group expects to receive, discounted at an                     流量與本集團預期收取的所有現金流量之間的差額而釐定，並以原實際利
                                                                approximation of the original effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will include cash flows           率的近似值折現。預期現金流量將包括出售所持抵押品的現金流量或組成
                                                                from the sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements that are integral to the contractual terms.        合約條款的其他信貸增級。


                                                                General approach                                                                                                 一般方法
                                                                ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which there has not been a significant               預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確認。就自初始確認後的信貸風險並無重大
                                                                increase in credit risk since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that result from          變動之信貸風險而言，對於未來12個月之可能違約事件產生之信貸虧損作
                                                                default events that are possible within the next 12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those credit                    出預期信貸虧損撥備（12個月預期信貸虧損）。就自初始確認後的信貸風險
                                                                exposures for which there has been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss       已出現重大增加之該等信貸風險而言，須對預期於風險之餘下年期之信貸      229
                                                                allowance is required for credit losses expected over the remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of        虧損作出虧損撥備，而不論違約時間（全期預期信貸虧損）。
